body:
weezer wrote...
> I agree 100% that "The mass media are mostly under the control of large
> organizations that are integrated into the system." Pretty much
> everything is controlled by large organizations these days. The bombs
> certainly caught the attention of everyone. There is no denying it. I
> simply cannot condone sending bombs to college professors, though.
> Perhaps a credit agency or cell phone executive, but not college
> professors. (This is a joke, please do not send any bombs to anyone.)

St. Ted explains his focus on college professors in the following letter
to the FBI:

----------------------------------------------------------------------
"All the university people whom we have attacked have been specialists
in technical fields.  (We consider certain areas of applied
psychology, such as behavior modification, to be technical fields.)
We would not want anyone to think that we have any desire to hurt
professors who study archaeology, history, literature or harmless
stuff like that.  The people we are out to get are the scientists and
engineers, especially in critical fields like computers and genetics."
-- The Unabomber
----------------------------------------------------------------------
